cards.title: Shell-Shadow Pencil Cup Clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper pencil cup opening card for starting an invented tidepool lab story from a pencil cup and one gentle time clue: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: draw a pencil cup with shell pencils, then choose a pretend tide mark together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Begin the tidepool lab story when the pencil cup shows the helper that the tide-time note has changed: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: write a sentence that starts with a tide mark, shell shadow, or jar line clue: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character arrival: invent the lab helper who notices the time clue first: ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place doorway: name the lab shelf, pool edge, driftwood desk, or jar table where the story opens: ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object invitation: choose the pencil, shell tag, bead marker, or kelp ruler that invites the story to begin: ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: ask what the tide clue means before anyone changes anything: ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: write the helper's first calm paper-note action: ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: add one exact tide, shell, shadow, or jar detail so the time clue is easy to picture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw the time clue in the pencil cup, then write one opening sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: fold this card with a pencil cup sketch and add a new invented tide clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Patchwork Oar Voice Start
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper pencil cup opening card for beginning a fictional Revision River Ferry story with a clear written voice: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the card beside a pencil cup sketch and offer one invented ferry word to start from: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Start the ferry story in a character's written voice before explaining the whole draft problem: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: write the ferry helper's first thought, note, or announcement in a distinct voice: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character arrival: invent the rider, pilot, or draft sorter who speaks first on the ferry: ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place doorway: name the dock, paper ferry deck, draft island, or ripple bend where the opening begins: ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object invitation: choose the colored pencil, oar tag, folded note, or map scrap that pulls the character aboard: ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: ask what the speaker wants to revise before the ferry leaves the dock: ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: write the first small ferry action that matches the speaker's voice: ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: replace one plain word with a sharper ferry, draft, dock, or pencil-cup word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the first voice line and underline the word that sounds most like the character: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: carry this card with a paper pencil cup and try a new ferry voice start: ____________________.

cards.title: Blank Tag Tower Reveal
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper pencil cup opening card for starting a fictional clue-label museum story when one label reveals the first clue: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: draw a pencil cup with blank exhibit tags tucked inside and keep every object invented: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Open the tower museum story by letting one label reveal something the character did not expect: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: write the sentence where the pencil-cup label reveals a clue, job, or question: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character arrival: invent the curator, label sorter, or clue finder who reads the tag first: ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place doorway: name the tower shelf, exhibit step, label drawer, or quiet display where the story opens: ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object invitation: choose the pencil, blank tag, tiny card, or paper magnifier that invites the first clue: ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: ask why this label points to the wrong, missing, or surprising exhibit: ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: write the character's first paper clue check after reading the label: ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: add one exact label shape, display surface, or pencil-cup detail to make the reveal clearer: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: sketch the label first, then write only the reveal sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save this card and invent another pencil-cup label reveal on a paper slip: ____________________.

cards.title: North-Bead Choice Hook
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper pencil cup opening card for beginning a fictional compass craft story with one choice that pulls the reader in: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: draw a paper compass beside the pencil cup and frame every direction as an invented story choice: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Start the compass craft story at the moment the character must choose which direction the pencil cup points: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: write a sentence that gives the character two possible directions before anything else happens: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character arrival: invent the map maker, craft apprentice, or path planner facing the choice: ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place doorway: name the map room, bead table, needle hall, or compass rail where the opening begins: ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object invitation: choose the pencil, paper needle, bead marker, folded arrow, or direction card that starts the choice: ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: ask which direction the character should trust and why: ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: write the first calm action the character takes to test one choice on paper: ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: add one clue that makes both choices feel possible but different: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: mark two compass points and write one opening choice sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: tuck this card with a pencil cup sketch and invent a new compass choice hook: ____________________.

cards.title: Button-Loop Promise Opening
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper pencil cup opening card for starting a fictional Binding Day Boardwalk story with one promise on the first page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: fold a blank booklet shape and draw a pencil cup holding pretend binding tools: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Open the boardwalk story by writing the promise the character wants to keep before the pages are ready: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: write the promise sentence that begins the booklet, boardwalk, or pencil-cup story: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character arrival: invent the binder, booklet helper, or page sorter who makes the promise: ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place doorway: name the boardwalk table, page booth, thread rail, or booklet stand where the opening begins: ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object invitation: choose the pencil, button tag, thread loop, page clasp, or folded sign that helps make the promise: ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: ask what might make the promise tricky to keep in this invented story: ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: write the character's first careful step toward keeping the promise on paper: ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: add one boardwalk, booklet, button, or pencil-cup detail that makes the promise feel specific: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the promise and draw the object that helps keep it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep this card with a folded paper booklet and add another promise opening: ____________________.
